DEADQUOTE_ALL_THAT_IS_NECESSARY.en: "All that is necessary for evil to succeed is for good men to do nothing." - Edmund Burke

DEADQUOTE_ALL_WARFARE_IS_BASED.en: "All warfare is based on deception." - Sun Tzu

DEADQUOTE_ALL_WARS_ARE_CIVIL_WARS.en: "All wars are civil wars, because all men are brothers." - Francois Fenelon

DEADQUOTE_ANYONE_WHO_TRULY_WANTS.en: "Anyone, who truly wants to go to war, has never truly been there before!" - Larry Reeves

DEADQUOTE_ANY_SOLDIER_WORTH_HIS.en: "Any soldier worth his salt should be anti-war. And yet there are things still worth fighting for." - General Norman Schwarzkopf

DEADQUOTE_A_LEADER_LEADS_BY_EXAMPLE.en: "A leader leads by example not by force." - Sun Tzu

DEADQUOTE_A_SHIP_WITHOUT_MARINES.en: "A ship without Marines is like a garment without buttons." - Admiral David D. Porter, USN

DEADQUOTE_A_SOLDIER_WILL_FIGHT.en: "A soldier will fight long and hard for a bit of colored ribbon." - Napoleon Bonaparte

DEADQUOTE_DEATH_IS_NOTHING_BUT.en: "Death is nothing, but to live defeated and inglorious is to die daily." - Napoleon Bonaparte

DEADQUOTE_DEATH_SOLVES_ALL_PROBLEMS.en: "Death solves all problems - no man, no problem." - Joseph Stalin

DEADQUOTE_FIVE_SECOND_FUSES_ONLY.en: "Five second fuses only last three seconds." - Infantry Journal

DEADQUOTE_FREEDOM_IS_NOT_FREE_BUT.en: "Freedom is not free, but the U.S. Marine Corps will pay most of your share." - Ned Dolan

DEADQUOTE_FROM_MY_ROTTING_BODY.en: "From my rotting body, flowers shall grow and I am in them and that is eternity." - Edvard Munch

DEADQUOTE_HE_WHO_DID_WELL_IN_WAR.en: "He who did well in war just earns the right to begin doing well in peace." - Robert Browning

DEADQUOTE_HE_WHO_FEARS_BEING_CONQUERED.en: "He who fears being conquered is sure of defeat." - Napoleon Bonaparte

DEADQUOTE_IF_A_MAN_DOES_HIS_BEST.en: "If a man does his best, what else is there?" - General George S. Patton

DEADQUOTE_IF_THE_ENEMY_IS_IN_RANGE.en: "If the enemy is in range, so are you." - Infantry Journal

DEADQUOTE_IF_WE_CANT_PERSUADE_NATIONS.en: "If we can't persuade nations with comparable values of the merits of our cause, we'd better reexamine our reasoning." - Robert McNamara

DEADQUOTE_IF_WE_DONT_END_WAR_WAR.en: "If we don't end war, war will end us." - H. G. Wells

DEADQUOTE_IF_YOUR_ATTACK_IS_GOING.en: "If your attack is going too well, you're walking into an ambush." - Infantry Journal

DEADQUOTE_IF_YOU_ARE_GOING_THROUGH.en: "If you are going through hell...keep going." - Winston Churchill

DEADQUOTE_IF_YOU_KNOW_THE_ENEMY.en: "If you know the enemy and know yourself, you need not fear the result of a hundred battles." - Sun-Tzu

DEADQUOTE_INCOMING_FIRE_HAS_THE.en: "Incoming fire has the right of way." - Unknown

DEADQUOTE_IN_MODERN_WAR_YOU_WILL.en: "In modern war... you will die like a dog for no good reason." - Ernest Hemingway

DEADQUOTE_IN_PEACE_AS_A_WISE_MAN.en: "In peace, as a wise man, he should make suitable preparation for war." - Horace

DEADQUOTE_IN_PEACE_THE_SONS_BURY.en: "In peace the sons bury their fathers, but in war the fathers bury their sons." - Croesus

DEADQUOTE_IN_THE_SOVIET_ARMY_IT.en: "In the Soviet army it takes more courage to retreat than advance." - Joseph Stalin

DEADQUOTE_IN_WAR_THERE_ARE_NO_UNWOUNDED.en: "In war, there are no unwounded soldiers." - Jose Narosky

DEADQUOTE_IN_WAR_THERE_IS_NO_PRIZE.en: "In war there is no prize for the runner-up." - General Omar Bradley

DEADQUOTE_IN_WAR_TRUTH_IS_THE_FIRST.en: "In war, truth is the first casualty." - Aeschylus

DEADQUOTE_IN_WAR_YOU_WIN_OR_LOSE.en: "In war, you win or lose, live or die-and the difference is just an eyelash." - General Douglas MacArthur

DEADQUOTE_IT_IS_FATAL_TO_ENTER.en: "It is fatal to enter any war without the will to win it." - General Douglas MacArthur

DEADQUOTE_IT_IS_FOOLISH_AND_WRONG.en: "It is foolish and wrong to mourn the men who died. Rather we should thank God that such men lived." - General George S. Patton

DEADQUOTE_IT_IS_GENERALLY_INADVISABLE.en: "It is generally inadvisable to eject directly over the area you just bombed." - U.S. Air Force Manual

DEADQUOTE_IT_IS_WELL_THAT_WAR_IS.en: "It is well that war is so terrible, or we should get too fond of it." - Robert E. Lee

DEADQUOTE_I_DONT_KNOW_WHETHER_WAR.en: "I don't know whether war is an interlude during peace, or peace is an interlude during war." - Georges Clemenceau

DEADQUOTE_I_HAVE_NEVER_ADVOCATED.en: "I have never advocated war except as a means of peace." - Ulysses S. Grant

DEADQUOTE_I_KNOW_NOT_WITH_WHAT.en: "I know not with what weapons World War III will be fought, but World War IV will be fought with sticks and stones." - Albert Einstein

DEADQUOTE_LET_YOUR_PLANS_BE_DARK.en: "Let your plans be dark and as impenetratable as night, and when you move, fall like a thunderbolt." - Sun Tzu

DEADQUOTE_MANKIND_MUST_PUT_AN_END.en: "Mankind must put an end to war, or war will put an end to mankind." - John F. Kennedy

DEADQUOTE_MAY_GOD_HAVE_MERCY_UPON.en: "May God have mercy upon my enemies, because I won't." - General George S. Patton

DEADQUOTE_MORE_THAN_AN_END_TO_WAR.en: "More than an end to war, we want an end to the beginnings of all wars." - Franklin D. Roosevelt

DEADQUOTE_MY_FIRST_WISH_IS_TO_SEE.en: "My first wish is to see this plague of mankind, war, banished from the earth." - George Washington

DEADQUOTE_NEARLY_ALL_MEN_CAN_STAND.en: "Nearly all men can stand adversity, but if you want to test a man's character, give him power." - Abraham Lincoln

DEADQUOTE_NEVER_IN_THE_FIELD_OF.en: "Never in the field of human conflict was so much owed by so many to so few." - Winston Churchill

DEADQUOTE_NEVER_THINK_THAT_WAR.en: "Never think that war, no matter how necessary, nor how justified, is not a crime." - Ernest Hemingway

DEADQUOTE_NEVER_YIELD_TO_FORCE.en: "Never yield to force; never yield to the apparently overwhelming might of the enemy." - Winston Churchill

DEADQUOTE_NO_ONE_CAN_GUARANTEE.en: "No one can guarantee success in war, but only deserve it." - Winston Churchill

DEADQUOTE_OLDER_MEN_DECLARE_WAR.en: "Older men declare war. But it is the youth that must fight and die." - Herbert Hoover

DEADQUOTE_ONLY_THE_DEAD_HAVE_SEEN.en: "Only the dead have seen the end of the war." - Plato

DEADQUOTE_PATRIOTS_ALWAYS_TALK.en: "Patriots always talk of dying for their country and never of killing for their country." - Bertrand Russell

DEADQUOTE_SOLDIERS_USUALLY_WIN.en: "Soldiers usually win the battles and generals get the credit for them." - Napoleon Bonaparte

DEADQUOTE_SOME_PEOPLE_LIVE_AN_ENTIRE.en: "Some people live an entire lifetime and wonder if they have ever made a difference in the world, but the Marines don't have that problem." - Ronald Reagan

DEADQUOTE_SO_LONG_AS_THERE_ARE.en: "So long as there are men there will be wars." - Albert Einstein

DEADQUOTE_SUCCESS_IS_NOT_FINAL.en: "Success is not final, failure is not fatal: it is the courage to continue that counts." - Winston Churchill

DEADQUOTE_TEAMWORK_IS_ESSENTIAL.en: "Teamwork is essential, it gives them other people to shoot at." - Unknown

DEADQUOTE_THEREFORE_WHOEVER_WISHES.en: "Therefore, whoever wishes for peace, let him prepare for war." - Vegetius

DEADQUOTE_THERES_NO_HONORABLE_WAY.en: "There is nothing good in war. Except its ending." - Abraham Lincoln

DEADQUOTE_THERE_ARE_ONLY_TWO_FORCES.en: "There are only two forces in the world, the sword and the spirit. In the long run the sword will always be conquered by the spirit." - Napoleon Bonaparte

DEADQUOTE_THERE_IS_NOTHING_SO_LIKELY.en: "There is nothing so likely to produce peace as to be well prepared to meet the enemy." - George Washington

DEADQUOTE_THERE_NEVER_WAS_A_GOOD_WAR.en: "There never was a good war or a bad peace." - Benjamin Franklin

DEADQUOTE_THE_BURSTING_RADIUS_OF.en: "The bursting radius of a hand-grenade is always one foot greater than your jumping range." - Unknown

DEADQUOTE_THE_DEADLIEST_WEAPON.en: "The deadliest weapon in the world is a Marine and his rifle!" - General John J. Pershing

DEADQUOTE_THE_DEATH_OF_ONE_MAN.en: "The death of one man is a tragedy. The death of millions is a statistic." - Joseph Stalin

DEADQUOTE_THE_ESSENCE_OF_WAR_IS.en: "The essence of war is violence. Moderation in war is imbecility." - John Arbuthnot Fisher

DEADQUOTE_THE_MILITARY_DONT_START.en: "The military don't start wars. Politicians start wars." - Gen. William Westmoreland

DEADQUOTE_THE_OBJECT_OF_WAR_IS.en: "The object of war is not to die for your country but to make the other bastard die for his." - General George S. Patton

DEADQUOTE_THE_ONLY_WINNER_IN_THE.en: "The only winner in the War of 1812 was Tchaikovsky." - Solomon Short

DEADQUOTE_THE_QUICKEST_WAY_OF_ENDING.en: "The quickest way of ending a war is to lose it." - George Orwell

DEADQUOTE_THE_REAL_AND_LASTING.en: "The real and lasting victories are those of peace, and not of war." - Ralph Waldo Emerson

DEADQUOTE_THE_REAL_WAR_WILL_NEVER.en: "The real war will never get in the books." - Walt Whitman

DEADQUOTE_THE_TRUTH_OF_THE_MATTER.en: "The truth of the matter is that you always know the right thing to do. The hard part is doing it." - General Norman Schwarzkopf

DEADQUOTE_TRACERS_WORK_BOTH_WAYS.en: "Tracers work both ways." - U.S. Army Ordnance

DEADQUOTE_TRY_TO_LOOK_UNIMPORTANT.en: "Try to look unimportant; they may be low on ammo." - Infantry Journal

DEADQUOTE_UNTUTORED_COURAGE_IS.en: "Untutored courage is useless in the face of educated bullets." - General George S. Patton

DEADQUOTE_WAR_DOES_NOT_DETERMINE.en: "War does not determine who is right - only who is left." - Bertrand Russell

DEADQUOTE_WAR_IS_AS_MUCH_A_PUNISHMENT.en: "War is as much a punishment to the punisher as it is to the sufferer." - Thomas Jefferson

DEADQUOTE_WAR_IS_CRUEL_AND_YOU.en: "War is cruel and you cannot refine it." - William Tecumseh Sherman

DEADQUOTE_WAR_IS_DELIGHTFUL_TO.en: "War is delightful to those who have not experienced it." - Erasmus

DEADQUOTE_WAR_IS_FEAR_CLOAKED_IN.en: "War is fear cloaked in courage." - Gen. William C. Westmoreland

DEADQUOTE_WAR_WOULD_END_IF_THE.en: "War would end if the dead could return." - Stanley Baldwin

DEADQUOTE_WE_MAKE_WAR_THAT_WE_MAY.en: "We make war that we may live in peace." - Aristotle

DEADQUOTE_WE_SLEEP_SAFELY_IN_OUR.en: "We sleep safely in our beds because rough men stand ready in the night to visit violence on those who would harm us." - George Orwell

DEADQUOTE_WHEN_THE_PIN_IS_PULLED.en: "When the pin is pulled, Mr. Grenade is not our friend." - U.S. Army Training Notice

DEADQUOTE_YOU_CANT_SAY_CIV.en: "You can't say civilization don't advance - for in every war, they kill you in a new way." - Will Rogers

DEADQUOTE_YOU_MUST_NOT_FIGHT_TOO.en: "You must not fight too often with one enemy, or you will teach him all your art of war." - Napoleon Bonaparte

SCRIPT_PLATFORM_HINT_PLANTEXPLOSIVES.en: Look at the explosives spot and press^3 &&1 ^7to plant the explosives.

SCRIPT_PLATFORM_HINT_RAISEFROMPRONETOCRO.en: Press^3 &&1 ^7to switch from crouch from prone.

SCRIPT_PLATFORM_HINT_SECONDWEAPONKEY.en: Press^3 &&1 ^7to switch to your second weapon.

SCRIPT_PLATFORM_HINT_SIGHTARTILLERY.en: Press^3 [{+binoculars}] ^7to look through your binoculars and direct artillery.

SCRIPT_PLATFORM_HINT_SIGHTARTILLERY_BREA.en: Press^3 [{+breath_binoculars}] ^7to look through your binoculars and direct artillery.

SCRIPT_PLATFORM_HINT_STANDFROMCROUCHKEY.en: Double tap^3 &&1 ^7to stand up from crouch.

SCRIPT_PLATFORM_HINT_STANDLETGOPRONEKEY.en: Let go of^3 &&1 ^7to come out of prone.

SCRIPT_PLATFORM_HINT_STANDLETGOSECONDKEY.en: If this makes you go prone, double tap^3 &&1].

SCRIPT_PLATFORM_HINT_STRAFELEFT.en: Press your Move Left key^3 &&1 ^7to move left.

SCRIPT_PLATFORM_HINT_STRAFERIGHT.en: Press your Move Right key^3 &&1 ^7to move right.

SCRIPT_PLATFORM_HINT_SWAPWEAPONSKEY.en: HOLD USE^3 &&1 ^7to swap your current weapon for another that you are looking at.

SCRIPT_PLATFORM_HINT_SWITCHTOSECONDWEAPO.en: You now have two weapons. Press^3 &&1 ^7to switch to your second weapon.
